ai.menuTip: Smart tools — they run on your computer, free and private
ai.downloadAsk: This AI feature needs a one-time download ({{size}}). It is stored on this computer and then works offline, free and private. Download now?
ai.bgDone: Background removed. It is a mask: use the Brush / Eraser on it (Layers → mask) to fix the edges.
ai.tooBigToUpscale: This picture is already too big for that. Try 2× or a smaller picture.
ai.modelsTitle: AI models (all run on your computer)
ai.modelsText: Each model is downloaded the first time you use it, then everything works offline.

assist.placeholder: Tell the AI what you want, e.g. “make it warmer and crop it for Instagram”
assist.suggestTip: The AI looks at your picture and proposes improvements
assist.nothing: The AI did not propose any change it can make.
assist.proposal: Here is what the AI proposes — untick anything you don't want, the picture updates right away:
assist.desktopOnly: The AI assistant works in the desktop app (not in the browser preview).
assist.noProvider: Choose an AI in AI settings first (free: Ollama on this computer).
assist.fillHint: Describe what should appear in the selected area. The AI paints it on a new layer; the rest of the picture stays exactly as it is.
assist.fillPlaceholder: e.g. “a small wooden boat”, “blue sky with clouds”
assist.fillNote: Needs OpenAI or Gemini in AI settings (they can edit pictures). The picture is sent to that service.
assist.filling: The AI is painting… this can take up to a minute
assist.fillDone: Done! It is on a new layer — hide or delete it if you don't like it.
assist.needSelection: Select an area first (Select tool), then describe what should appear there.

aiset.title: AI settings
aiset.intro: The free AI tools (remove background, erase objects…) always work offline. Here you can also connect a chat AI that edits for you when you describe what you want.
aiset.geminiNote: API key (free tier) · can also paint
aiset.keySafe: The key is encrypted with Windows and stored only on this computer. It is sent only to that company's server.
aiset.claudeCredits: Note: a claude.ai subscription (Pro/Max) does not include API credits — the API is paid separately at console.anthropic.com.
aiset.claudePrice: Prices are per million tokens (input / output). One request usually costs well under 1 cent.
aiset.ollamaFound: {{n}} models found in Ollama. For best results pick one that supports tools (e.g. qwen2.5, llama3.1).
aiset.ollamaMissing: Ollama is not running or has no models. Start Ollama and download a model (e.g. “ollama pull qwen2.5:7b”).
aiset.sendImage: Let the AI see the picture (a small copy) for better suggestions
aiset.privacyCloud: Your request (and the small copy of the picture, if allowed) is sent to this company. Nothing is sent until you press Ask.

mode.proTip: All tools: blend modes, extra sliders, clone stamp

tool.selectTip: Select part of the picture (M, L, W)
tool.brushTip: Paint (B) — Alt+click picks a color, Shift+click draws a straight line
tool.cloneTip: Copy one part of the picture onto another (S) — Alt+click to choose the source
tool.magicTip: Remove objects with AI (R): paint over what you want gone
tool.magicHint: Paint over the object you want to remove, then let go — the AI fills the gap.
tool.object: Object (AI) — click on something to select it
tool.subject: Subject
tool.fillTip: Fill an area or draw a gradient (G)
tool.eyedropperTip: Pick a color from the picture (I)
tool.handTip: Move around the picture (H) — or hold Space
tool.moveHint: Drag to move · corners to resize · round handle to rotate · Shift = free resize
tool.handHint: Drag to look around. Scroll to zoom. Tip: hold Space with any tool.
tool.textHint: Click on the picture to add text, or click existing text to edit it.
tool.shapeHint: Drag on the picture to draw · Shift = perfect square / circle / 45°
tool.eyedropperHint: Click the picture to use that color.
tool.cloneHint: Alt+click where to copy from, then paint where to copy to.
tool.maskHint: Painting on the MASK: brush hides, eraser shows again.
tool.noLayer: Select a layer to transform it

adjust.autoTip: Let the app improve the photo automatically
adjust.resetTip: Reset all adjustments of this layer
adjust.noLayer: Select a layer to adjust it.
adjust.proHint: Switch to Advanced for exposure, clarity, grain and more.

look.hint: Filters are applied on top of your adjustments and can be changed any time.

layers.addMask: Add mask — hide parts of this layer without deleting them
layers.maskEdit: Click to paint on the mask
layers.rasterize: Convert to pixels (to paint on it)

history.empty: Your edits will appear here. Click any step to go back to it.

welcome.title: What would you like to do?
welcome.subtitle: Drop a photo anywhere, paste one with Ctrl+V, or pick an option below.
welcome.openDesc: Open a picture from your computer
welcome.blankDesc: Choose a size and create something new
welcome.removeBgDesc: Open a photo and cut out the subject with AI

dialog.resizeHint: Everything in the picture gets bigger or smaller.
dialog.canvasHint: Adds or removes space around the picture without stretching it.
dialog.aboutText: An easy photo editor that does all image work on your graphics card.
dialog.selHint: Soften makes a smooth, gradual edge. Grow and Shrink move the edge out or in.

export.title: Export image
export.jpgHint: JPG — best for photos, small files. No transparency.
export.pngHint: PNG — perfect quality and transparency, bigger files.
export.webpHint: WebP — small files with transparency, great for the web.

msg.notImage: This file type is not supported. Try JPG, PNG, WebP or PSD.
msg.tooBig: The picture was very large and was reduced to {{w}} × {{h}} px.
msg.noWebgl: Your graphics card could not be used. Please update your graphics drivers.
msg.autoDone: Auto enhance applied — use the sliders to fine-tune.
msg.discard: You have unsaved changes. Continue without saving them?
msg.autoLayer: Added a new layer to paint on — your text/shape stays editable.
msg.notPixelLayer: This works on picture layers. Select a picture layer (or convert this one to pixels).
msg.cloneSource: Source picked. Now paint where you want the copy.
msg.cloneNeedsSource: First Alt+click on the part of the picture you want to copy.
msg.bucketMask: Use the brush or a gradient to edit a mask.
msg.maskHint: Mask added: paint with the Brush to hide, with the Eraser to show again.
msg.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard

recent.title: Recent
recent.missing: That file is no longer there (moved or deleted). It was removed from the list.

recover.title: Your last work was not saved
recover.text: The app closed unexpectedly while “{{name}}” was open. A copy from {{time}} was kept.
recover.done: Your work is back. Save it (Ctrl+S) to keep it.

psd.skipped: Photoshop file opened. {{n}} part(s) could not be copied exactly (adjustment layers, layer styles or special blend modes) and look a bit different.

tpl.title: Start from a template
tpl.hint: Double-click any text to change it. Everything is a layer you can move, recolour or delete.
tpl.quoteText:
Do what you love,
love what you do.
tpl.bdaySub: WITH LOVE, FROM ALL OF US

tour.toolsText: Pick a tool here: move, select, crop, brush, text, shapes… Hover a tool to see its name and keyboard shortcut.
tour.panelText: Sliders for light and colour, one-click filters, layers and the history of every change. Double-click a slider to reset it.
tour.aiText: Remove the background, erase objects, enlarge pictures — free and on your computer. Press Ctrl+K to tell the AI what you want.
tour.modeText: Simple shows only the essentials. Advanced adds blend modes, masks, the clone stamp and extra sliders.
tour.exportText: Export makes a JPG / PNG / WebP to share. Ctrl+S saves the project with all layers, so you can change it later.

err.notProject: This is not an EasyStudio Photo project.
err.newerVersion: This project was made with a newer version of the app. Please update EasyStudio Photo.
err.damaged: The project file is damaged (some picture data is missing).
err.psdNoData: This PSD file has no picture data this app can read.

proBenefits.ai: Unlimited AI: remove backgrounds, erase objects, enlarge 2× / 4×
proBenefits.export: Export at full resolution (up to 16384 px) and as WebP
proBenefits.future: Every new Pro feature in future updates
